bugs.what: Selecting 'wait here (leaves the party for now)' in a companion dialogue menu actually removes them from the party mid-conversation, which reads as a continuation option rather than a dismissal — cost a wasted turn re-recruiting Tamsin.
bugs.where: companion dialogue menus, e.g. The Forge / Tamsin

bugs.what: 'Call it a draw' style will-checks to defuse companion disputes carry real fail chance and visibly worse consequences (both companions disapprove) than simply picking a side, making the 'neutral' option a trap roughly half the time.

confusions: The game never states party size limits; I recruited all 4 companions without any pushback or warning, so it's unclear if a cap exists or matters.

Locating specific named sub-areas (e.g. the Hundred Gallery, the drowned nave, the Hollow Throne stair) sometimes required blind directional wandering even after 'get your bearings' — bearings gave partial info that didn't always cover the quest target, forcing trial-and-error room-hopping.
It was never fully clear whether 'a bargain' vs a full 'rest' for a hold both count toward the '3 hollows rested' threshold the same way, though the status screen eventually clarified this.

The distinction between 'the true founding record' (Wardmoor) and 'the first Reeve's confession' (needed for the throne) wasn't obvious until actually reaching the tomb — the journal text implied they might be the same document.
suggestions: Rename 'wait here (leaves the party for now)' to something less like a benign pause option, or add a confirmation, since it reads as reversible small talk.
Show the DC and running success odds more consistently before a will/wits gamble against companions, not just after failing once.

Add a lightweight 'quest waypoint' hint (e.g. distance/direction) once a location is named in dialogue, similar to what 'get your bearings' already does, so late-game long treks (Iron Downs, Hollowbrook, Marrowgate) are less trial-and-error.
Surface party size/composition rules (if any) explicitly, since nothing ever indicated a limit despite recruiting 4 companions freely.
